question: Capture actual host RAM, global PSI, cgroup and VRAM telemetry during one existing SOL TP=2 smoke, then compare behavior with ASTRA DEFAULT 1M's successful high-RSS trace.
scope: One deterministic ~24K-token prompt-copy request; telemetry validation only. No A/B, throughput claim, synthetic memory pressure, production profile change, model deletion, app/server termination outside this unique Q127 container, or Codex crash attribution.

guard.name: AMD05 candidate; not production-integrated
rules: Immediate stop if host MemAvailable <32 GiB or global oom_kill increases
Stop after 15 consecutive 1-second samples with (global PSI full avg10 >=60% OR some avg10 >=80%) AND MemAvailable <48 GiB
Do not stop based on RSS alone
Stop only the Q127 container on new cgroup OOM/OOM-kill, cgroup swap increase >4 MiB, telemetry failure, or foreign inference server detection

preflightGates: No active inference process/container and no pre-existing listener on 18117
Both physical GPU indexes 0 and 1 visible; each <80 C
Exact SHA-256 match for Q34 compose, override, and seven SOL model shards
procedure: python syntax validation of runner and pinned guard dependencies
Q121 verify-only with the pinned runner and AMD05 hashes
Run the runner once only if every gate passes
Make exactly one prompt-copy request; require HTTP 200 and 20,000-30,000 reported prompt tokens
Collect 1 Hz host MemAvailable/SwapFree/PSI/OOM, container cgroup RSS/current/peak/events/swap, and per-GPU VRAM/temperature
Stop only q127-sol-memory; verify its container is absent and `ss -H -ltn sport = :18117` reports no listener (TIME_WAIT does not count).

decisionCriteria.pass: Q121 passes, the single request returns HTTP 200 with prompt token count in range, trace is nonempty, AMD05 does not abort, no new OOM/cgroup swap, and cleanup confirms the Q127 container is absent and TCP port 18117 has no listening socket. TIME_WAIT is not a listener.
decisionCriteria.blocked: Any preflight gate fails; do not start model and do not retry in this iteration.
decisionCriteria.fail: A started attempt misses its request/telemetry/cleanup criterion; preserve logs and do not retry.
decisionCriteria.interpretationLimit: One SOL trace can validate the monitor and describe this workload; it cannot prove severe-pressure sensitivity, establish a model winner, justify production integration, or identify why Codex closed. A high RSS with healthy MemAvailable and no sustained global PSI must not be labeled harmful pressure.

sourceEvidence: Q118 ASTRA DEFAULT 1M actual trace: 1,001,463 tokens, max RSS 51.306 GiB, min MemAvailable 58.698 GiB, host PSI some peak 53.61%, no stop/OOM/swap; replay 12/12
Q34 SOL TP=2: 30/30 speed requests completed without OOM; no continuous PSI trace
Q126 AMD05 CPU boundary regression: 4/4 checks passed; candidate only, not integrated

amendments.reason: Tighten isolation and fail-closed telemetry before the first model start.
changes: Preflight refuses any existing Q127 compose-project container, including stopped containers, so this run cannot reuse or clean up a prior container.
Require cgroup memory.current, memory.peak, memory.swap.current and memory.events with oom/oom_kill counters.
Abort only the Q127 container if the first cgroup sample is already OOM/swapped, if required cgroup telemetry disappears, or if the previously monitored cgroup vanishes.

amendments.reason: Attempt01 completed the model request and compose down, but its bind-based port-free check treated two TIME_WAIT connections as a live listener. Read-only inspection found no LISTEN socket, no Q127 container, and no Q127/inference process.
changes: Use `ss -H -ltn sport = :PORT` to test for a listening socket instead of bind(), which can fail while a closed connection remains in TIME_WAIT.
Run a CPU-only regression against the real Q127 TIME_WAIT state and a controlled loopback listener on a separate test port.
Do not rerun SOL inference; reconcile cleanup only after the listener regression, container absence, and process checks pass.

amendments.reason: The A02 regression harness loaded run_sol_trace.py with importlib but omitted the script directory from sys.path; the failure occurred before port checks, while Q121 had already shown the normal launcher can import the guard.
changes: Correct only the CPU regression harness import path by adding the runner script directory to sys.path before module execution.
Repeat the already-preregistered port semantic check: real Q127 port accepts TIME_WAIT/no LISTEN; a controlled listener on a separate loopback port is rejected; after close the port is accepted.
No runner source, model request, inference server, or GPU change/retry.
